title: fix(plugin-grid): while selecting, Enter or Space on a phone card's row menu ticks the card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbD5gxSWeWGswbZYVzNvtqNM)_
Fixes #36315
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 手机宽度的列表卡片在多选状态下,用键盘在某张卡片的「⋮」上按回车或空格,现在只勾选/取消这张卡片,不再弹出行操作菜单;退出多选后按键照常打开菜单。
- 补齐手机卡片多选的最后一个漏口:之前只拦住了点按,键盘仍能打开菜单。
- 只影响多选状态下卡片内按键的走向;出错时最坏是按键不勾选卡片,可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `buildMobileCardRenderer` only: the phone card gains an `onKeyDownCapture` that, while the card list is selecting, stops Enter, Space and ArrowDown on any control inside the card (not the card itself, not a portal node) from reaching that control's own handler.

Measured mechanism: the 「⋮」 is a Radix `DropdownMenuTrigger`, which opens on keydown (Enter / Space toggle, ArrowDown opens), so the existing pointer-down / click-capture tap guard never saw it. The guard does **not** `preventDefault`, so the browser still turns Enter and Space on the button into its native click, and the existing `onClickCapture` (the tap guard) turns that click into the tick. ArrowDown makes no click: it now does nothing while selecting. The tap guard is untouched.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/cardSelection-35883.test.tsx`, beside the existing tap pins:

- `it.each(['{Enter}', ' '])` — while selecting, focus the 「⋮」, press the key: no `menu` role, card `aria-pressed="true"`, `onRowSelect` last called with the row; then ArrowDown opens no menu either; after 「×」 the same key opens the menu.
- Enter on the email link inside a selecting card ticks the card and opens nothing (the card's note said this already held; it was unpinned — pinned, nothing changed there).

Before/after: on the unfixed tree (pins added, guard absent) the two `it.each` cases are red (`expected <div data-side="bottom" …> to be null` — the Radix menu content), the link pin is green; with the guard, the file is 16/16.

## Acceptance notes

- ArrowDown on the trigger also opened the menu while selecting; it is guarded in the same line (the card's acceptance names Enter/Space only).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/cardSelection-35883.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1` — expect 16 passed.

Read first: the `onKeyDownCapture` hunk in `ObjectGrid.tsx` (it relies on not calling `preventDefault` so the native click still happens).
